verdict.rationale: The IRS runs credentialed machine channels: MeF requires Authorized e-file Provider enrollment, and IRIS A2A is gated by a Transmitter Control Code. Neither lets a user issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The third-party designee rail is a human delegation with signed authorization, not an agent credential, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
